name: weekday_successor
description: Name the weekday k (1-3) days after a given weekday. Control: same format with letters of the alphabet.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday']
A='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW'
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    k=random.choice([1,2,3])
    shots=random.sample(range(7),2); q=random.randrange(7)
    p=''.join(f"{k} day(s) after {D[a]} is {D[(a+k)%7]}.\n" for a in shots)+f"{k} day(s) after {D[q]} is"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+D[(q+k)%7]})
    s2=random.sample(range(20),2); q2=random.randrange(20)
    p2=''.join(f"{k} letter(s) after {A[a]} is {A[a+k]}.\n" for a in s2)+f"{k} letter(s) after {A[q2]} is"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":" "+A[q2+k]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
